changelog:

- Fetches full product information from Taobao or Tmall product pages by itemId, including title, price, shop info, images, SKU variants, and attributes.
- Requires browser session with user logged in; performs pre-checks for tool readiness and authentication.
- Implements extraction via Python scripts on live product page, handling common popups.
- Handles both Taobao and Tmall pages; outputs structured JSON with all key product fields.
- Includes usage guidance for batch processing, error resumption, and experience-based strategy adjustments.
